M18 — 2026-10-09
Publishing from the operator's phone (npm auth-type=web, passkey 2FA): non-TTY `npm publish` fails EOTP with the approval link masked as `***`. Run it in a pty instead: `(while true; do printf '\n'; sleep 4; done) | script -q LOG sh -c 'npm publish …'`. npm then prints the link unmasked and polls, and the operator approves it on the phone. One approval with the 5-minute skip covered all six packages. Newly published versions spend a few minutes in npm's validation before `npm view` shows them.
